phases.title: Fragment Classification Request Boundary
acceptance: the only 7.6 entry path consumes PlanarBooleanOverlapRegionLedgerReceipt plus an admitted operation profile
PlanarBooleanFragmentClassificationRequest carries operation profile identity and semantic-graph carry-forward proof
raw fragments, raw loops, copied overlap rows, untyped operation strings, and unproven carry-forward fail before subject recovery
phases.instructions: Implement Phase 1 from the 7.6 spec as the request-boundary lane. Start by rereading the spec, the 7.5 overlap ledger surfaces, the touched-graph roadmap, operators-list.md, validators.md, and Forge Query AI_README.
phases.qa_focus: No raw-geometry request construction, no copied route summaries, no list-order subtraction direction, and no classification-local semantic graph proof.

phases.title: Classification Catalog Operator Binding
acceptance: existing boolean classification catalog operators map to exactly one 7.6 classification class
new milestone-scoped proof operators are subordinate to the public catalog operator families
classification-affecting operators without catalog binding fail closeout certification
phases.instructions: Bind existing catalog operators to the milestone-specific proof products before any classification helpers spread across crates.
phases.qa_focus: No unnamed classify/filter/apply_boolean_rule helpers and no second public classifier vocabulary.

phases.title: Classification Registered Family And Validator Routing
acceptance: one registered family binding routes validators, diagnostics, replay, evidence, and ambiguity posture
the binding consumes inherited touched graph proof and overlap-product proof
operator-local validator, diagnostic, replay, evidence, or ambiguity lists fail closeout certification
phases.instructions: Make validator routing part of the ordinary classification architecture before operation semantics are implemented.
phases.qa_focus: No deferred validator registration, no local lists, and no registered-family bypass.

phases.title: Classification Fragment Subject Recovery
acceptance: PlanarBooleanClassificationFragmentUniverseReceipt is recovered only from the 7.5 overlap ledger receipt
subject set, subject-kind map, provenance map, and overlap binding include non-overlap and overlap-adjacent subjects
dangling, foreign, duplicated, incomplete, or overlap-ledger-unbacked subjects deny before support-field construction
phases.instructions: Recover the full classification universe from ledger authority, including A-only, B-only, containment-only, disjoint, untouched, hole-boundary, and overlap-adjacent subjects.
phases.qa_focus: No subject discovery by raw split fragments, loop walks, arrangement cells, overlap chains, or pairwise scans.

phases.title: Classification Support Field Construction
acceptance: support field and predicate authority are rebuildable from overlap-ledger and projection-consumption proof
support counters expose subjects, inherited overlap products, projection receipts, and missing-support denials
raw arrangement cells, local point-in-polygon helpers, direct materialization reads, and local tolerance choices fail public-contract proof
phases.instructions: Build support as derived state with inherited predicate authority, not as a new geometry authority.
phases.qa_focus: No coordinate recomputation, no new epsilon model, and no bridge-only materialization reads.

phases.title: Boundary Posture Classification
acceptance: boundary-only, shared-boundary, mixed boundary/area, source operand, overlap-region link, and denial posture remain typed
boundary posture is stable across replay and reversed source-edge sense where semantics permit
area membership claims from boundary-only overlap outcomes deny before operation-rule lowering
phases.instructions: Classify boundary posture before inside/outside membership or operation-specific keep/discard rules can consume it.
phases.qa_focus: No on_boundary boolean, no boundary-only-to-area promotion, and no generic boundary failure bucket.

phases.title: Operand Membership Classification
acceptance: membership outcomes are operand-local, operation-neutral, and support-field-backed
inside, outside, boundary, overlap-interior, overlap-boundary, ambiguous, and unsupported remain distinct
raw coordinate tests, missing support evidence, and contradictory membership deny before overlap classification
phases.instructions: Classify each subject relative to each operand without executing operation semantics or subtraction direction.
phases.qa_focus: No point-in-polygon reruns as the ordinary path and no binary membership truth value.

phases.title: Coplanar Overlap Fragment Classification
acceptance: overlap fragments classify separately from ordinary non-overlap fragments
shared-area, boundary-only, mixed boundary/area, and opposite-sense outcomes are stable across replay
missing or inconsistent inherited region, winding, or mixed-boundary/area evidence denies before keep/discard assignment
phases.instructions: Preserve overlap-region truth from 7.5 as operation-neutral classification facts.
phases.qa_focus: No treating overlap fragments as ordinary inside/outside rows with metadata and no lost opposite-sense normalization.

phases.title: Boolean Operation Rule Lowering
acceptance: union, intersection, and subtraction lower into one explicit operation rule plan
rule plans trace to catalog keep/discard and ambiguity operators
missing operation profile, swapped subtraction authority, unsupported operations, boolean-only plans, and catalog bypasses deny
phases.instructions: Lower operation semantics into a rule plan before terminal classification executes.
phases.qa_focus: No scattered executor conditionals, no vector-position subtraction direction, and no untraceable keep/discard strategy.

phases.title: Terminal Classification And Result Contribution Assignment
acceptance: every admitted subject receives exactly one terminal outcome or typed localized denial
result contribution carries result side, orientation action, source role, operation role, boundary preservation, and downstream assembly posture
unclassified subjects, duplicate terminal rows, missing contribution sense, hidden operation branching, and boundary-only-to-area promotion deny before ambiguity classification
phases.instructions: Execute the lowered rule plan and assign terminal outcome plus result contribution posture for every admitted subject.
phases.qa_focus: No orphaned subjects, no final face identity, no implicit orientation, and no keep/discard rows without contribution semantics.

phases.title: Ambiguity Classification
acceptance: ambiguous outcomes are explicit terminal-classification products routed through the catalog ambiguity operator
ambiguity localization names missing support, conflicting evidence, unsupported contact, or operation-policy pressure
ambiguous rows cannot masquerade as kept, discarded, denied, or policy-exited rows
phases.instructions: Model ambiguity as a first-class terminal posture instead of a catch-all failure or diagnostic note.
phases.qa_focus: No silent fallback to discard, no diagnostics-only ambiguity, and no ambiguity path outside registered-family routing.

phases.title: Policy-Required Exit And Recovery Posture
acceptance: policy exits are typed terminal outcomes distinct from ambiguity and local denial
exit rows carry recovery posture, unsupported-operation reason, and downstream handoff impact
unsupported policy paths cannot be hidden as discard, ambiguity, or successful keep rows
phases.instructions: Separate policy-required exits from ambiguous or locally denied classifications before ordering and counters.
phases.qa_focus: No generic unsupported bucket, no lost recovery posture, and no policy exit that still contributes to result geometry.

phases.title: Deterministic Classification Ordering
acceptance: classification ordering basis is stable across replay, benign input ordering, and hash-map variation
ordering consumes typed subject, overlap, rule, terminal, contribution, ambiguity, and policy-exit products
missing tie-breakers, unstable ordering, and hash-dependent traversal fail before identity minting
phases.instructions: Make deterministic ordering a proof product consumed by identity and ledger assembly.
phases.qa_focus: No formatting-only ordering, no incidental map iteration order, and no order-dependent identities.

phases.title: Classification Counters And Complexity Proof
acceptance: classification counters cover subjects, overlap bindings, support rows, posture rows, membership rows, rules, kept, discarded, ambiguous, policy exits, and denials
the production-confidence path proves O(S + R + P + M + B + O)
raw-loop, raw-edge, repeated containment, and pairwise rediscovery shapes fail complexity proof
phases.instructions: Freeze visible cost accounting after deterministic ordering is stable.
phases.qa_focus: No elapsed-time-only performance proof and no broad scans hidden behind certification.

phases.title: Classified Fragment Identity
acceptance: classified-fragment identities, persistent names, subshape signatures, and naming seeds derive from terminal proof, ordering, and counters
naming seeds carry source role, operation role, result side, orientation action, subject kind, source loop, overlap-region, and containment-only provenance
duplicate identities, dangling names, unsupported naming seeds, and raw keep/discard identity rows deny before handoff construction
phases.instructions: Mint classified-fragment identity without widening into final face, hole, shell, body, or topology conflict identity.
phases.qa_focus: No final face naming semantics and no identity from raw rows without terminal posture proof.

phases.title: Face Assembly Input Handoff
acceptance: PlanarBooleanFaceAssemblyInputHandoff carries terminal posture, contribution, identity, naming, ambiguity, and policy-exit products
the handoff is a prepared spatial product and not a topology mutation
missing identity, terminal posture, or policy-exit rows deny before ledger assembly
phases.instructions: Prepare the only raw handoff product 7.7 may receive, while reserving authority for the later ledger receipt.
phases.qa_focus: No raw keep/discard inspection by face assembly and no final face, hole, shell, body, or conflict decisions.

phases.title: Classification Decision Log And Ledger Assembly
acceptance: one decision log records every typed branch and downstream-visible classification outcome
PlanarBooleanFragmentClassificationLedgerReceipt is the only downstream authority accepted by 7.7

PlanarBooleanFaceAssemblyInputHandoffReceipt is minted by ledger assembly and preserves unified route, family, product, witness, Query posture, residue, source-firewall, and architecture-claim identity
phases.instructions: Assemble the canonical classification decision log, ledger, ledger receipt, and face-assembly handoff receipt from prior proof products only.
phases.qa_focus: No summarized rows, no diagnostic-richness identity drift, no locally derived route identity, and no raw handoff authority.

phases.title: Workload Evidence And Stage Requirement
acceptance: fragment classification has its own evidence receipt and workload-stage requirement
evidence proves overlap receipt, semantic-graph carry-forward, registered family binding, operation profile, operator matrix, validator plan, and classification ledger receipt participated
synthetic evidence, manual keep/discard rows, copied labels, bypassed overlap proof, and local route summaries fail stage requirement
phases.instructions: Make classification a real workload stage with typed evidence instead of piggy-backing on overlap evidence.
phases.qa_focus: No evidence that proves only execution and no evidence-as-validator substitute.

phases.title: Replay And Checkpoint Parity
acceptance: classification replay and checkpoint receipts preserve ledger, keep/discard, ambiguity, identity, naming, handoff, semantic-graph carry-forward, and registered family binding
replay consumes the classification ledger instead of reconstructing from raw fragments
raw loops, raw scans, bypassed overlap proof, local summaries, and serialized-row-only replay fail parity
phases.instructions: Prove the canonical classification ledger is replay-safe and checkpoint-safe.
phases.qa_focus: No replay success if any classification, identity, naming, handoff, or family-binding truth drifts.

phases.title: Public Contract And Anti-Theatre Fences
acceptance: public contracts expose receipts and proof status without public authority constructors
anti-theatre proof admits the real workload-backed classification receipt chain and rejects forged products
synthetic ledgers, raw fragment keep/discard rows, raw overlap rows, copied selected-route digests, local support summaries, and pseudo-Query proof fail compile-fail/source-firewall proof
phases.instructions: Fence the classification lane against forged products, bypassed ledgers, and local pseudo-Query proof before closeout.
phases.qa_focus: No optional source-firewall proof and no public bypass constructor.

phases.title: Summum Bonum Closeout Certification
acceptance: planar_boolean_fragment_classification_metaboss_preserves_operation_truth_across_coplanar_overlap_boundary_and_subtraction_pressure is the summum bonum closeout

the metaboss proves stable request digest, operation-rule plan digest, classification-ledger digest, keep/discard outcomes, ambiguity outcomes, classified identities, and assembly handoff across replay, ordering variation, and checkpoint consumption
boundary-only-to-area promotion, reversed subtraction roles, mixed-overlap collapse, ambiguity bypass, raw-fragment overlap bypass, and classification-local route lanes deny with typed localization
phases.instructions: Run the hostile closeout program and do not close 7.6 unless the unified touched-graph route chain remains sufficient and the catalog operators remain the public semantic lane.
phases.qa_focus: No synthetic closeout rows, no local helper fixtures as primary proof, no reopened touched graph/Query/split/loop/overlap work, and no second classifier.
